notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard HLAfederation MIM object, standard variable-array data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It requests the standard joined-federate roster and verifies conditional values after one federate joins and resigns, without depending on roster order or provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador MIM federation creation, join/resign, standard MOM lookup and subscription, attribute value request, federate-handle decoding, and federation destruction with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: RTIambassador::createFederationExecutionWithMIM, RTIambassador::joinFederationExecution, RTIambassador::resignFederationExecution, RTIambassador::getObjectClassHandle, RTIambassador::getAttributeHandle, RTIambassador::subscribeObjectClassAttributes, RTIambassador::requestAttributeValueUpdate, RTIambassador::decodeFederateHandle, RTIambassador::destroyFederationExecution, FederateAmbassador::discoverObjectInstance, FederateAmbassador::reflectAttributeValues, HLAvariableArray, HLAbyte
